core_obligations: Test the definition: take an arbitrary quasi-compact stack with a morphism to the apex of the triangle (proof lines 2028-2029)
Surjectivity is preserved by the base change along that morphism (proof lines 2030-2032)

Quasi-compactness of the fibre product with the source follows from quasi-compactness of the test object, and quasi-compactness of the fibre product with the target follows from the criterion for a surjective morphism onto it (proof lines 2033-2039)
proof_roadmap: 按准紧的定义检验：取任意准紧的 T 与 T → Z。
基变换后 T ×_Z X → T ×_Z Y 仍满；又 T ×_Z X 准紧。
由「沿满射提升准紧性」的判据得 T ×_Z Y 准紧，即 q 准紧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a 2-commutative triangle of morphisms of algebraic stacks, quasi-compactness of one leg together with surjectivity of the opposite arrow forces quasi-compactness of the remaining leg (author lemma at source lines 2013-2025, label lemma-surjection-from-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 2027-2041) tests the definition of quasi-compactness against an arbitrary quasi-compact stack mapping to the apex, uses that surjectivity survives base change, and concludes with the criterion that quasi-compactness descends along a surjective morphism (proof lines 2028-2039). The verification of the defining property at an arbitrary test object is the content. H2.
